title: Hornsdale Power Reserve: Phase 56G Acquisition Check
summary: AEMO's asset-specific Hornsdale record on this rail remains the supplementary regulation-MW dataset for December 10, 2017 through January 7, 2018 under element HPRG1. Phase 56G decision: No closure change. The official rail exposes a short historical interval record, not a later annual availability and dispatch series.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Annual availability and dispatch under a declared service denominator.
Continuation rule: Reopen when AEMO, AER, the South Australian government, or the operator publishes an asset-specific annual operating series.
why_it_matters: The acquisition check tests one named reopening rule without allowing adjacent context to stand in for the requested operating or closure record.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the stable entity ID battery-hornsdale-power-reserve.
Records the exact official or first-party rail checked and the result at a date.
Separates a useful contextual record from the narrower evidence needed to change closure state.
evidence_limits: A four-week historical regulation-MW extract cannot be generalized into later annual availability, dispatch, degradation, revenue, safety, or customer outcomes.
Annual availability, dispatch, service enablement and delivery, cycling, degradation, revenue, safety, and customer outcomes.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
